{{Disambig|Soul}}

==Enemies==
'''Soul''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Elite Soul]], a high health [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] and [[Ghost (Attribute)|ghost]] enemy that first appears on Wave 41 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and on Wave 42 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode
*[[Fallen Soul]], a [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] enemy that first appears on Wave 10 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Soul/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Soul]], a [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] and [[Ghost (Attribute)|ghost]] enemy that first appears on Wave 37 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and on Wave 41 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode

'''Soul''' may also refer to these removed enemies:
*[[Fallen Soul (Legacy)]], an enemy that can debuff towers, summoned by the [[Fallen Reaper]] in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode
*[[Soul Boss]], a [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] and [[Ghost (Attribute)|ghost]] enemy that first appeared on Wave 46 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode
*[[Soul Stealer (Legacy)]], an enemy that can spawn [[Soul]]s and debuff towers that first appeared on Wave 45 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode

'''Soul''' may also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Korblox Soul (The Classic)]], a [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] enemy that first appeared on Wave 3 in [[Classic Winter]] and Wave 5 in [[Classic Island Chaos]] and [[Classic Castle]]
*[[Korblox Soul (The Hunt)]], a [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] enemy that first appeared on Wave 3 in [[Huevous Hunt]]
**[[Korblox Soul (The Hunt)/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Korblox Soul (The Hunt: Mega Edition)]], a [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] enemy that first appeared on Wave 3 in [[Korblox Temple]]
**[[Korblox Soul (The Hunt: Mega Edition)/Advanced Stats]]
